name: Yurika
source:
Yurika is a kouhai and the girlfriend of [url=https://vndb.org/c10022]Kuurin[/url] in 1999.

She idolizes Kuurin and she is deeply in love with her, but we do not know if Kuurin really regarded her as her girlfriend or as a one night stand partner.

[spoiler]As they are about to make love, Yurika tells Yuurin that she has changed because of this "[url=https://vndb.org/c10020]damn boy[/url]" and is very jealous.
She's afraid Kuurin will leave her for him.[/spoiler]

The trait "Sex with Others" only concerns her and Kuurin because they sleep together.
